dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you still thinking of a name?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: That's right! We worked so hard to get the decor right, but now it doesn't match the name I had in mind... What a headache!

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Gah! I didn't expect my dream coming true to come hand in hand with all these nuisances...
